div.head: II As 23.2
div.ab: ⁊ ofga ylc man his tyhtan mid foreaþ, swa we ær cwædon; ⁊ beo ðæra ylc fæstende on ægþere hand ðe ðær sy, be Godes bebode ⁊ ðæs bisceopes; ⁊ ne beo ðær on nawþre healfa ma manne ðonne XII. Gif ðonne se getyhtleda man maran weorod sy þonne XII sum, ðonne sy þæt ordale forode, buton hi him fram gán wille.

⁊ ofga ælc mon his tihtlan mid foreaðe, swa we ær cwædon; ⁊ beo þæra ælc fæstende on ægþera hond se ðær mid sy, (on) Godes bebode ⁊ ðæs ærcebiscopes; ⁊ ne beo ðær on naþre healf (na) ma monna þonne XII. Gif se getihtloda mon ðonne maran werude beo þonne twelfa sum, þonne beo þæt ordal forod, buton hy him from gan willon.

⁊ ofga ælc man his … mid foreaþe, swa we ær cwædon; ⁊ beo ðara ælc fæst … hand þe ðær mid sie, Godes bebode ⁊ þæs ærcebisc …; .. on nauþre healfe ma manna ðonne XII. Gif se ge … :onne maran weorode sie ðonne XII sum, þonne sie þæt or …, .. hie him fram gan willen.

Et prosequatur omnis homo compellationem suam preiuramento, sicut supra dictum est. Et sint utrimque ieiuni, ex precepto Dei et archiepiscopi, et non sint in alterutra parte amplius quam in alia et hoc sit utrimque XII homines. Si uero (autem) accusatus homo maiorem defensionem habeat quam XII hominum, sit ipsum ordalium in eo fractum, nisi recedere uelint ab eo (illo).

⁊ ofga ælc mon his tihtlan mid foreaðe, swa we ær cwædon; ⁊ beo þæra ælc fæstende on ægþera hond se ðær mid sy, on Godes bebode ⁊ ðæs ærcebiscopes; ⁊ ne beo ðær on naþre healf na ma monna þonne XII. Gif se getihtloda mon ðonne maran werude beo þonne twelfa sum, þonne beo þæt ordal forod, buton hy him from gan willon.

And every man shall precede his accusation with an oath, as we have already declared, and everyone who is present in both parties shall fast according to the command of God and the archbishop. And there shall not be more than twelve on either side. If, however, the accused man is one of a party greater than twelve, the ordeal shall be invalidated, unless they will leave him.

And each man is to obtain [the right to pursue] his charge by a preliminary oath, as we have said before; and each of those of both parties who is present is to be fasting, according to the command of God and of the archbishop; and there are not to be on either side more men than twelve. If the accused man then is one of a larger company than twelve, the ordeal is then invalidated, unless they will leave him.

Und jedermann erreiche seine Klage [zwinge Verklagten zum Beweise] durch [seinen] Voreid, wie wir zuvor bestimmt haben; und es faste auf beiden Seiten jeder von ihnen, der dabei steht, laut Gottes und des Erzbischofs Gebot; und es sei da auf keiner Seite mehr an Männern [anwesend] als [je] 12. Wenn der verklagte Mann aber von grösserer Männerschaar [begleitet] ist als selbzwölft, so sei dann dies Ordal gescheitert, es sei denn, sie [die mehr als 12] wollen von ihm fortgehen.

And let everyone pursue his charge [compel the accused to proof] by [his] fore-oath, as we determined before; and on both sides let each of those who stand there fast, by the command of God and of the archbishop; and let there be no more men [present] on either side than 12 [each]. But if the accused man is [accompanied] by a larger band of men than himself and eleven others, then let the ordeal be void, unless they [those over 12] are willing to leave him.
div.note: From the ambiguity of the expression twelfa sum (see p. 159, n. 11), it is uncertain whether this figure is inclusive of the defendant or not.
